task_title: AUG-125: the published XSD loads in a real XSD 1.0 processor and every shipped fixture is graded against it (fix 4481afb, graded at the current merged head)
task_criteria: The shipped conformance suite for the published XSD passes on this tree: tests/test_xsd_conformance.py collects and passes 12 tests with no failures or errors. FAILIF: any failure or error, or a passed count other than 12. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py

Board AC1, directly: a conforming XSD 1.0 processor loads specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd with no exception. lxml 6.1.3 is the processor (xmllint is not installed on this host, so the lxml route is the one that must hold). FAILIF: XMLSchemaParseError or any non-zero exit. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; from lxml import etree; etree.XMLSchema(etree.parse(sys.argv[1]))" specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd; echo xsd_load_rc=$?

Board AC2: every shipped fixture corpus is graded against the shipped XSD, not just one sample - the fixture arm passes and the corpus holds 7 directories under tests/fixtures/xml/ (context, expected, invalid, methods, rollback, specs, verification), so a code-acceptable but schema-invalid document is refused while the accepted corpora still validate. FAILIF: the fixture test does not pass, or the directory count is not 7. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py::test_every_shipped_fixture_is_schema_valid_or_refused; echo fixture_rc=$?; ls -d tests/fixtures/xml/*/ | wc -l

Board AC3, the falsifier direction: the PRE-FIX schema at cf5bfe2 uses the Python-dialect non-capturing group and is REFUSED by the same processor, so the load test is not vacuous and the parity test fails when a facet is rewritten into a dialect the processor rejects. FAILIF: the pre-fix schema loads (rc 0), which would mean the loading arm proves nothing about the defect. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && git show cf5bfe2:specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd > /tmp/prefix125.xsd && .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; from lxml import etree; etree.XMLSchema(etree.parse(sys.argv[1]))" /tmp/prefix125.xsd; echo prefix_load_rc=$?

Board AC4: the xs:pattern facets express the same LANGUAGE as the Python validator, checked with accepted and rejected samples in both directions (directional parity, not string identity), including the stable-id length limit. FAILIF: any failure, or a passed count other than 4. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py::test_pattern_facets_express_the_same_language_as_the_code tests/test_xsd_conformance.py::test_the_stable_id_facet_carries_the_length_limit_too

The proof cannot silently leave the gate and it grades the landed fix: tests/gate.sh names tests/test_xsd_conformance.py in its pytest arm (2 occurrences measured), that arm-pinning test passes, and the implementation commit 4481afb is an ancestor of the judged HEAD. FAILIF: the file is absent from the arm, the pinning test fails, or the ancestry check exits non-zero. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -c "tests/test_xsd_conformance.py" tests/gate.sh; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py::test_gate_arm_runs_this_file; git merge-base --is-ancestor 4481afb HEAD; echo ancestor_rc=$?

items.criterion: The schema gate is reachable from the CLI entrypoint: `auger spec validate`/`check` loads the shipped XSD and refuses a schema-invalid document (not just the test helper).
items.detail: `python auger.py spec validate tests/fixtures/xml/invalid/schema-invalid` -> `spec error (schema-invalid): undeclared-attribute.xml:18: Element '{urn:auger:spec:1}requirement', attribute 'severity': The attribute 'severity' is not allowed. items.criterion: The stable-id length limit is enforced by the shipped XSD itself (maxLength on stableId), not only asserted in the test.

items.criterion: The fix does not break the rest of the spec surface: tests/test_xml_specs.py and tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py still pass.
items.detail: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py` -> `84 passed in 7.00s`, exit_code 0.

All accepted corpora (context, methods, rollback, specs, verification) return []. The test additionally asserts `any(layer == "schema-invalid")`.

items.criterion: The gate's pytest arm actually runs the conformance file (the named line is the executed pytest invocation, not a comment/echo).
items.detail: tests/gate.sh:206 is `setsid timeout --kill-after=... python3 -m pytest tests/test_auger.py ... tests/test_xsd_conformance.py ... "$@" || rc=$?` — the executed invocation, not a comment. test_gate_arm_runs_this_file filters lines containing "python3 -m pytest" and asserts the file is in arm[0]; it passes (1 passed).
